selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 reach each other directly on any port with original source addresses preserved

selected_evidence.requirement: Implemented using Ansible from the designated control node (node4)
selected_evidence.summary: node4 is the antrieb:ansible-controller:v1 image; inventory.ini and lan-to-lan-routing.yml were placed there, syntax-checked, and executed via the node's run.sh (EXECUTED_FILE convention), with the router and lan_hosts plays completing with ok/changed and no failures.

# Check required files exist
